# HueWhimsy

> Whimsical children's books and creative learning resources for ages 3 to 8. Hand-illustrated books, free printable activities, educational toys, and custom illustration services.

HueWhimsy designs whimsical alphabet books and creative learning experiences for young children. Our flagship series features Rilo (curious explorer) and Rivy (supportive guide), characters who help children aged 3-8 learn phonics, develop fine motor skills, and explore creativity through coloring, writing, and storytelling.

## Core offerings

- **Children's books** — Alphabet Fun series (Floral, Fruity, Veggie editions), with new themed volumes (Landmark, Animal, Dinosaur) on the way
- **Free printable activities** — Coloring pages, alphabet flashcards, drawing prompts, welcome packs
- **Educational toys & supplies** — Watercolor sets, alphabet blocks, writing pads, eco-friendly creative tools
- **Custom services** — Website design, AI agent setup, custom illustration, coloring page commissions, book design, logo design

## Audience

- Parents of children aged 3-8 seeking high-quality phonics and creative-learning materials
- Educators and homeschool families looking for printable activities
- Authors, brands, and educators commissioning custom illustration or book design

## Brand values

- Hand-illustrated, never AI-generated art
- Kid-first design tested with children aged 3-8
- Cozy, screen-free learning experiences
- Always whimsical — joy and curiosity in every product
